title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第1章 永恒领域！
content_zh:
耳畔响起沙沙的电磁音，许默渐渐恢复意识，整个身体就像是浸泡在湖水中，阴冷潮湿，闷得他几乎喘不过气。

“好冷~”

“怎么回事？”

许默睁开眼，荒原上弥漫着白雾，婆娑的树影显得无比怪诞，任凭湿冷的寒风穿过，然后发出呢喃般诡异的尖啸……

他不是躺在家里吗？

这是哪？

【欢迎来到永恒领域！】

【恭喜诸位，作为蓝星的幸运儿，将有机会见证永恒！】

【作为新手福利，请牢记这句话：永远不要试图改变永恒领域的世界规则！你们的目标只有一个：活着！】

电磁音消失的很是突兀，周围安静的又只剩下了风声。

许默脸色紧绷，脑海中还在不断重复着刚刚那句提示的时候，一道信息界面毫无预兆的映入眼帘。

【属性】【频道】【交易】【制作】

许默闭上眼睛，压住内心的恐惧，片刻后，他深吸一口气，开始研究眼前的界面，首先是【频道】-【局域频道】。

心念微动后，一个新的界面就弹了出来。

【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：7023】

【编号56742681：老天……谁知道现在是什么情况？有没有能解释一下的？】

【编号36485268：到处都是森林，看着好吓人，我想回家。】

【编号24621584：这是生存游戏？光说别改变规则，特么什么规则倒是说清楚啊！】

局域频道内，此刻已经炸了锅，人们惊慌且疑惑，许默眉头紧皱的翻看着，大多数人的第一反应都跟他差不多。

就在他也准备发送消息的时候，一道提示忽然弹出。

【发送局域频道内容，需要消耗理智值：1点理智值/次】

保险起见，许默没有轻举妄动，转而点开了【属性】。

【幸存者编号：66448231】

【生存能力：6】

【生命：150/150】

【饱腹：123/150】

【干渴：138/150】

【理智：148/150】

【体力：149/150】

【负重：0/15】

【天赋-酿酒师：你无需任何食谱，即可尝试酿造各种酒水，饮用后获得不同效果。】

【装备：暂无】

【道具：暂无】

看着眼前简单的几乎没有额外说明的属性面板，许默眉头紧锁，生命、饱腹、干渴乃至于体力，他通过字面意思都能猜到。

关键是这个理智。

上面显示，当前理智是148，从开始到现在他什么都没做，怎么会凭空消耗？一旦理智过低，会发生什么事情？

疯掉吗？

“开局并不算好啊。”

许默叹了口气，揉了揉眉心，他尽力整理着已有的信息。

首先，从频道内容来看，每个人所在的地区类型应该都不尽相同，目前已知的除了自己所在的荒原外，还有就是类似森林的地貌。

至于各有什么危险，暂且不知。

其次他观察到，从开始到现在，即便他什么都不做，各项当前属性都会不同程度的减少，尤其是饱腹/干渴这两项，目前为止，就只剩下一百出头了。

既然是生存游戏，食物和水源都是当务之急。

想到这，许默当即动身。

周围的土地很是贫瘠，浓雾弥漫下，肉眼能见度很低，许默随手扯了把零星可见的枯草，很快就响起系统提示。

【获得“枯草”X1】

除了名称外，没有任何多余的介绍。

负重栏内，多了个枯草的选项，负重显示也变成了1/15。

走了大概十几米远后，他看到了地上一簇掉落的树枝，本着不知道有什么用，先捡起来再说的原则……

【获得“树枝”X1】

依旧没有任何介绍。

周围静的可怕，耳畔的风声不断，不论许默走到哪里，四周都只有永无止境的贫瘠荒原和白色的雾气。

就这样，许默一边收集着仅能看到的两种资源，一边向四周探索着。

当人长时间处于相似不变的环境，尤其是没有参照物的时候，很容易迷失方向，所以许默每走一段时间，都会刻意的返回一截，查看是否有自己刚才留下的标记。

没有地图，他只能用这种笨办法。

尽管这样会降低探索效率，但至少能保证他始终在朝一个方向前进，而不是在原地转圈。

【获得“枯草”X1】

【获得“树枝”X1】

过了不知多久，许默的体力值已经消耗过半，身体的虚弱感越发强烈，他的视线里终于出现了不同的东西。

那是一片平静的水潭，周围的草地也稍显翠绿了几分。

“水！”

许默眼前一亮，但却没有多少喜色。

荒野求生的时候发现水源，对于任何人而言，都算的上一件高兴的事情，可眼前这片未知的世界完全不能用常理推测。

谨慎起见，许默并不想贸然上前饮用。

可看了眼自己仅剩的只有17点的【干渴值】后，许默还是决定冒险一试，或许可以通过游戏判断。

【获得“水”X1】

双手捧起潭水的瞬间，系统声音如约而至，没有异常标注，就是简简单单的水。

许默喝了一小口，干渴值立刻上涨了35点，过了一会，没有任何异样，许默放下了戒心，大口大口吞咽，直到干渴值恢复到了150点满值才停下。

摆在面前的麻烦，还有另外一件……

【饱腹：21/150】

强烈饥饿导致腹部的灼烧感越发强烈，许默一边忍受着胃部的痉挛，一边脸色泛白的环顾四周，试图寻找任何可以食用的东西。

可水潭四周除了草地，便只有偶尔从空中落下的鸟雀，许默稍一靠近，对方就展翅飞走了。

很显然，没有工具就试图抓鸟，是痴心妄想。

又过了一段时间……

【饱腹：0/150】

许默的步伐开始变得虚浮，视线开始变得模糊，面板上原本【150/150】的生命值，正在缓慢降低。

再这么下去，他会死！

许默脑海警铃大作，强烈的危机感袭来，可目光所及除了一些鸟雀留下的粪便……等等！

许默忽然想到什么，猛地抓起一小片鸟粪。

【获得“鸟粪”X1，“种子”X1】

鸟类粪便里面大概率会有植物种子，至于种子能做什么？别忘了他的天赋职业！

眼前的视线越发模糊，许默不敢再耽搁，当即打开【制作】。

几个可供制作的选项，当即弹了出来，【坚固石斧】、【坚固石镐】、【简易火把】、以及【酿酒】。

点开【酿酒】后，弹出了几个填充框。

他尝试着放了1单位的水进去，旁边又添加了“种子”，可下面的制作选项，依旧是灰扑扑的。

“怎么回事？是配方不对？还是比例不够？”

电光火石间，许默脑海中闪过了无数种可能，没办法，他只能赌是种子的数量不够。

【生命值：117/150】

许默争分夺秒的，又在鸟粪中找到了一些种子，两个不够，三个……还是不够，当许默放进去第四个的时候，制作图标终于亮了起来。

许默激动的嘴唇都有些颤抖，系统提示也弹了出来。

【获得“酒水”X1】

【生命值：91/150】

content_en:
There was a rustling electromagnetic sound in his ears, and Xu Mo gradually regained consciousness. His whole body felt like it was soaked in lake water, cold and damp, so stuffy that he could hardly breathe.

"It's so cold~"

"What's going on?"

Xu Mo opened his eyes, and saw that the wilderness was filled with white mist, and the shadows of the dancing trees looked extremely weird. The cold and wet wind passed through, and then emitted a weird scream like a whisper...

Isn't he lying at home?

Where is this?

【Welcome to the eternal realm!】

[Congratulations to all of you, as the lucky ones of Blue Star, you will have the opportunity to witness eternity!】

[As a bonus for newbies, please remember this sentence: Never try to change the world rules of the eternal realm!You have only one goal: stay alive!】

The electromagnetic sound disappeared suddenly, and only the sound of wind was left in the quiet surroundings.

Xu Mo's face was tense, and while he was still repeating the reminder in his mind, an information interface came into view without warning.

[Attribute][Channel][Transaction][Production]

Xu Mo closed his eyes and suppressed the fear in his heart. After a moment, he took a deep breath and began to study the interface in front of him, first of all, [Channel] - [Local Channel].

After thinking slightly, a new interface popped up.

[Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 7023]

[Number 56742681: God... who knows what the situation is now?Can anyone explain it?】

[Number 36485268: There are forests everywhere. It looks so scary. I want to go home.】

[No. 24621584: Is this a survival game?Just say don’t change the rules, what kind of rules should you make clear!】

The local channel was already in a state of panic. People were panicked and confused. Xu Mo looked through the pages with a frown on his face. Most people's first reaction was similar to his.

Just when he was about to send the message, a prompt suddenly popped up.

[Sending local channel content requires sanity points: 1 sanity point/time]

To be on the safe side, Xu Mo did not act rashly and instead clicked on [Attributes].

[Survivor number: 66448231]

[Survival ability: 6]

【Life: 150/150】

【Full stomach: 123/150】

【Thirst: 138/150】

[Sanity: 148/150]

[Stamina: 149/150]

[Weight load: 0/15]

[Talent - Brewer: You can try brewing various drinks without any recipes, and you will get different effects after drinking them.】

[Equipment: None]

[Props: None]

Looking at the simple attribute panel in front of him with almost no additional explanation, Xu Mo frowned. He could guess life, fullness, thirst and even physical strength from the literal meaning.

The key is this reason.

The above shows that the current sanity is 148. He has done nothing from the beginning to now, so how can he consume it out of thin air?What happens when your sanity is too low?

Going crazy?

"It didn't start well."

Xu Mo sighed, rubbed his brows, and tried his best to sort out the existing information.

First of all, judging from the content of the channel, everyone should be in a different type of area. Currently, in addition to the wasteland where they are, there are also forest-like landforms.

As for the dangers each poses, I don’t know yet.

Secondly, he observed that from the beginning to now, even if he did nothing, all the current attributes would decrease to varying degrees, especially the two items of fullness/thirst. So far, only a little over a hundred are left.

Since this is a survival game, food and water are top priorities.

Thinking of this, Xu Mo set off immediately.

The surrounding land was very barren, and under the thick fog, visibility was very low. Xu Mo casually pulled away some scattered dead grass, and soon a system prompt sounded.

[Obtain "Withered Grass" X1]

Apart from the name, there is no extra introduction.

In the load column, there is an additional option for dead grass, and the load display also changes to 1/15.

After walking about ten meters away, he saw a cluster of fallen branches on the ground. Based on the principle of not knowing what the use was, he picked it up first...

[Obtain "Twig" X1]

Still no introduction.

The surroundings were eerily quiet, and the wind kept ringing in his ears. No matter where Xu Mo went, he was surrounded by endless barren wasteland and white mist.

In this way, Xu Mo collected the only two resources he could see while exploring the surroundings.

When people are in a similar and unchanging environment for a long time, especially when there is no reference object, it is easy to lose direction, so Xu Mo would deliberately go back a little bit every time he walked for a period of time to see if there were any marks he had just left.

Without a map, he could only use this stupid method.

Although this will reduce the efficiency of exploration, it can at least ensure that he is always moving in one direction instead of spinning in circles.

[Obtain "Withered Grass" X1]

[Obtain "Twig" X1]

After an unknown amount of time, Xu Mo's physical strength had been depleted by more than half, and his body felt increasingly weak. Finally, something different appeared in his sight.

It was a calm pool, and the surrounding grass was a little greener.

"Water!"

Xu Mo's eyes lit up, but he didn't look happy.

Discovering a source of water while surviving in the wilderness is a happy event for anyone, but the unknown world in front of us cannot be speculated using common sense.

To be cautious, Xu Mo didn't want to rush forward to drink.

But after seeing that he only had 17 points of [Thirst] left, Xu Mo decided to take the risk and maybe judge it through the game.

[Get "Water" X1]

The moment he held the pool of water in his hands, the system voice came as promised. There was no abnormality mark, it was just plain water.

Xu Mo took a sip, and his thirst level immediately increased by 35 points. After a while, nothing was out of the ordinary. Xu Mo let down his guard and swallowed big gulps until his thirst level returned to the full value of 150 points.

There is another trouble ahead...

【Full belly: 21/150】

The intense hunger caused the burning sensation in his abdomen to become more intense. Xu Mo endured the cramps in his stomach while looking around with a pale face, trying to find anything edible.

But besides the grass around the pool, there were only birds that occasionally fell from the sky. As soon as Xu Mo came closer, the birds spread their wings and flew away.

Obviously, trying to catch birds without tools is wishful thinking.

Some time passed...

【Fullness: 0/150】

Xu Mo's steps began to become frivolous, his vision began to become blurred, and the health value originally [150/150] on the panel was slowly decreasing.

If this continues, he will die!

Alarm bells rang in Xu Mo's mind, and a strong sense of crisis came over him, but all he could see was the droppings left by some birds... Wait!

Xu Mo suddenly thought of something and suddenly grabbed a small piece of bird droppings.

[Obtain "guano" x1, "seed" x1]

Bird feces will most likely contain plant seeds. What can the seeds do?Don’t forget his gifted career!

The vision in front of him became increasingly blurry. Xu Mo did not dare to delay any longer and immediately opened [Production].

Several crafting options popped up immediately, including [Solid Stone Axe], [Solid Stone Pickaxe], [Simple Torch], and [Wine Brewing].

After clicking [Wine Brewing], several filling boxes popped up.

He tried putting 1 unit of water in and added "seeds" next to it, but the production options below were still gray.

"What's going on? Is the formula wrong? Or is the ratio not enough?"

In the flash of lightning, countless possibilities flashed through Xu Mo's mind. He had no choice but to bet that the number of seeds was not enough.

[HP: 117/150]

Xu Mo raced against time and found some more seeds in the bird droppings. Two were not enough, three... were still not enough. When Xu Mo put in the fourth one, the production icon finally lit up.

Xu Mo's lips trembled with excitement, and a system prompt popped up.

【Get "Drink" X1】

[HP: 91/150]

Illegal request-2
